text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D for gains did not prevent my account from falling that month; I should not treat a realized profit as proof that selling was the right decision.","I sold Stock C at a steep loss, then bought Stock B and Stock E at higher prices after selling them earlier; before trading, I should compare the new opportunity with simply keeping what I already own.","I rarely check my account, so I should make each trade decision using the current outlook and a clear plan—not act impulsively to soothe regret or celebrate a gain."]}
